featured_reviews.name: Siddhesh Patil
featured_reviews.review_text:
Last night, around 10 PM, my Bullet 350 suddenly broke down while I was riding through Worli. I needed to get back to Goregaon, but the bike just wouldn’t start due to a technical fault. With no idea what to do, I searched for garages nearby and BR Auto Scooter Services & Repairs came up on top. I called the owner, Babu Shaikh and to my surprise, he promised to come within 10 minutes — and he actually did.

Babu Bhai arrived along with his helper Shalam, and both of them genuinely tried every possible method to get my bike started. When it was clear that the bike wouldn’t run, they didn’t just leave me stranded. Instead, they promised to tow my bike all the way to Goregaon. I took a cab and reached home by 11:15 PM, and these two incredible men reached Goregaon with my bike by 11:25 PM, safely and without any complaints.

I am honestly beyond grateful. In times like these, you realize how rare it is to meet genuinely good-hearted people. I didn’t just get my bike helped — I met two humans who reminded me that kindness still exists.

Thank you so much, Babu Bhai and Shalam.
Your honesty, dedication, and willingness to help during someone’s worst moment truly deserve appreciation.

If anyone ever needs reliable, quick, and genuine two-wheeler roadside assistance or repair service around Worli or nearby areas — I 100% recommend BR Auto.

Respect and gratitude to both of you. 🙏❤️

featured_reviews.review_text:
Velocrush is such a fantastic initiative for cycling lovers in Mumbai! 🚴‍♂️I’ve only tried their rental service so far and the experience has been noiceee from start to finish. The booking process is super smooth and transparent and the team sticks to the promised timelines, making the entire pick-up and return process hassle-free. The cycles are comfortable, maintained and perfect for exploring the city - we’ve tried both geared and non-geared ones for rides to the Worli Promenade and each time has been a great and memorable experience! ✨

What I appreciate the most is how approachable and open to feedback Abhishek and the team are. They genuinely care about the rider experience and ask for feedback after the ride, which is commendable. 🙌

Highly recommend them if you want to explore our city on wheels! 🤍

featured_reviews.name: Kulsum Z. C
featured_reviews.review_text:
Recently went for a midnight cycling session with VeloRush, and honestly, it was a frustrating experience from start to finish.

The contact person, Naman, was completely unreachable after payment. I called him over 10 times before the session started and got no response. Had to reach out to a random person on the WhatsApp group just to get any update. Not a great sign.

We drove 35km to get there, arriving by 11pm, only to be told that all cycles were occupied and there were none available for us. My sister understandably lost her patience. After a lot of back-and-forth and arguments, he managed to arrange 3 cycles but it really shouldn't have come to that.

The ride itself was 25km with zero breaks in between, wrapping up before 3am somewhere around 2:30am. Here's the problem local trains in Mumbai don't start until around 4am, so those who needed to travel back by train were left waiting over 2 hour at Prabhadevi station in the dead of night. Ending the session so early without accounting for how people would get home felt genuinely irresponsible.

If you're planning to attend a VeloRush event, go in with low expectations on communication and logistics. The ride itself is fine, but the organising needs serious improvement.

Happy Cycling 🤙🫶🏻

The event was exceptionally well-organised and thoughtfully curated. The bikes provided were top-notch—high quality, properly maintained, and a pleasure to ride. The entire cycling run was incredibly enjoyable, covering a scenic 28 km route from Worli to Flora via Marine Lines.

Genuinely enjoyed every moment of the ride. Highly recommend VeloCrush to anyone looking for a professionally managed and joyful cycling experience in Mumbai!

featured_reviews.name: SHIVAM RANAWAT
featured_reviews.review_text:
⭐ 1 Star Review

Absolutely disappointed and frustrated with my experience at this bike accessories store. I trusted them with my helmet something that’s not just expensive, but also very personal and crucial for my safety and I honestly regret that decision now.

I had given my helmet to them to get it professionally painted, expecting quality work, attention to detail, and basic professionalism. What I got instead was a ruined helmet with poor finishing, uneven paintwork, and scratches that weren’t even there when I handed it over. The helmet looks far worse than when I gave it in, and they’ve completely destroyed its original look.

When I tried to politely raise my concerns and explain that this was not what I paid for, I was met with complete arrogance and abuse from the owner. Rather than being apologetic or trying to fix the situation, he became aggressive, loud, and extremely disrespectful, as if I was the one at fault for expecting a decent job. There was no sense of accountability or customer service.

It’s sad that some businesses think they can treat their customers this way and get away with it. I’m sharing this review to warn others if you’re thinking of giving them your helmet or any of your gear for customization or servicing, please think twice. There are plenty of other stores out there who will treat you with respect and deliver what they promise. This is not one of them.

I don’t usually write negative reviews, but this experience was just too unprofessional and upsetting to ignore.

featured_reviews.name: Romil Joshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
Where do I begin? For the past 2 years I wanted to get my 1987 Yamaha Rx100 customized but was reluctant to do as I was not sure and confident that it would turn out as I want it to. (I know a couple of friends who've had bad experiences) Then I got to know about YC design through social media and I followed Yogi's work for a year and finally was convinced to get the job done.

And what a masterpiece he has delivered!! Not only he customized the bike exactly how I wanted, but also added his expertise and touch to get all the finer details to perfection. The bike feels brand new - straight out of showroom!
